{{Historical content|All scarabs have been replaced with [[thread]]s in [[Version 3.30.0]].}} {{Item |rarity_id = normal |name = Horned Scarab of Glittering |class_id = MapFragment |size_x = 1 |size_y = 1 |flavour_text = Wealth flows to those that shine brightest. |drop_level = 81 |tags = scarab, uber_scarab, mythic_scarab, default |metadata_id = Metadata/Items/Scarabs/ScarabUber6 |help_text = Can be used in a personal Map Device to add modifiers to a Map. |stack_size = 20 |description = Players in Area gain increased Item Rarity for each Monster
slain, up to 400%, decaying over time |stack_size_currency_tab = 10000 |is_in_game = false |removal_version = 3.30.0 |map_fragment_limit = 1 |map_fragment_bonus1 = ScarabUber6 |release_version = 3.24.0 |recipe1_description = Random {{c|white|Horned Scarab}} x6 |recipe1_part1_item_name = The Silly Boy |recipe1_part1_amount = 9 }} '''Horned Scarab of Glittering''' is a [[scarab]]. ==Mechanics== Killing monsters will grant a temporary invisible buff that increases player [[IIR|item rarity]] based on the rarity of the enemy, similar to {{il|Whakawairua Tuahu}}: {| class="wikitable" |+ IIR scaling |- ! Monster Rarity !! IIR |- | Normal || 10% |- | Magic || 30% |- | Rare || 50% |- | Unique || 200% |} This bonus is capped at 200% increased Rarity from kills and decays at a rate of 10% per second. The bonus does not decay past the IIR of your character excluding these buffs. {{Item acquisition}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.30.0| *Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place. *Existing Scarabs will be converted to either a Thread related to that specific Scarab content, or a Frayed Thread. }} {{Version history table row|3.26.0| * Horned Scarab of Glittering now has Players in Area gain increased Item Rarity for each Monster slain, up to 400%, decaying over time (from up to 200%. No longer grants Item Quantity. Note the decay rate is no longer described as recently, as it was never over 4 seconds but was 20 seconds from the maximum value) }} {{Version history table row|3.24.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Items}}
